title: Bosch Series 4 60cm Fully-Integrated Dishwasher SMV4HTX01A $867.70 + $40 Delivery @ Bing Lee
body:
Deal: Bosch Series 4 60cm Fully-Integrated Dishwasher SMV4HTX01A $867.70 + $40 Delivery @ Bing Lee

[hen dawg] I successfully got appliances online to price match the freestanding series 4 at $909. (With Bing Lee $6 postage)
Initially they said no as, like you, the link only worked via Google search. When you share that link it comes up with the high price
[TerryTightwad] Yeah so it's a pretty good price as the integrated ones are a bit more, should be cheaper as they have no door
[catbarf] Coming up as $933 for Vic. I can't seem to get your price?
[TerryTightwad] Did you try searching it in Google? With adblockers off?
[TerryTightwad] I replicated the price with Google Chrome, sorry no way to share the actual link at this price
[TerryTightwad] Definitely available for Victoria, it's also showing as free delivery
[catbarf] Weird. I tried with ad blocker off, Google Chrome and still got $933. Is there a way to send the Google search link to the website? I will try again
[catbarf] Finally got it to work. Comes up as sponsored product using the Google app (not chrome for me)
[TerryTightwad] Works for me on both, and can also be intermittent. I thought the deal ended but then it came back.
[Herb Utsmellz] The Turkish made Bosch dishwashers are terrible compared to the German made ones. I went from the German made model to a Turkish one and after 3 months pulled it out and sold it on FB marketplace.
[TerryTightwad] oh no, is it really that bad? What is wrong with it? It was choosing between that and a kleenmaid.
[00] Turkish machines have commonly occupied Series 2/4, while German Series 6/8 models.
The latter can have better insulation/noise suppression, more sophisticated racks, better drying arrangements, different tub construction and additional features.
So it’s more about the product tier and price point than just being better or worse based on location they’re made.
[IMadeYouReadThis] I have the one made in Turkey and have been working really well for over 5 years. The only negative is that it’s sooooo quiet that I have to go multiple times to check if the cycle is done.
[boomramada] dishwashers are terrible compared to the German made ones
So what's the issue ?
[montorola] Do the dishes come out smelling like Pide?
[hen dawg] Chill out. They're still great products with best in class reliability. Not everyone wants to spend $1,300 plus to clean dishes
[wibgyor] It says the door panel is not included. So it’s freestanding then? What’s the difference between freestanding and integrated?
[vanZwalker] They're generally an open carcass style front rather than a typical freestanding front, so that a front panel in your cabinetry style can be attached/mounted.
